terms.metaDescription: The terms of service for using Fakturcho.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms of service govern the relationship between {legalName} and any person who uses the {productName} web application at {website}. By registering an account, the user accepts the terms in this document.

sections.heading: 1. Service provider
paragraphs: The service is provided by {entityLine}.
Contact us at {supportEmail}. We reply to inquiries within five business days.

sections.heading: 2. What the service is
paragraphs: {productName} is a web application through which a Bulgarian company or a self-insured sole trader composes and issues commercial documents — invoices, proformas, credit and debit notes, quotes and delivery notes — and downloads them as a PDF file.

The application prepares documents from the data entered by the user. It is not an accounting service, does not file documents with the Bulgarian tax authority (NAP), and does not replace accounting or tax advice.
Each account represents a single issuer with its own list of clients, catalogue and numbering series.

sections.heading: 3. Registration and account
paragraphs: Using the service requires registration with a valid email address and password. The user is responsible for safeguarding their access credentials and for all actions taken through their account.
The user represents that the data entered for the issuer and for clients is accurate and that they are entitled to process it. The content of issued documents is the user's sole responsibility.

sections.heading: 4. Prices and payment
paragraphs: Issuing each document costs {perDocument}. The amount is deducted from the account's credit balance the moment the document is assigned a number. Composing and saving drafts, clients and catalogue items is free.
Credit is topped up through one-off packs priced at {packs}. Alternatively, a subscription of {subscription} allows issuing without deducting credit while it is active.
A new account receives a one-off credit of {signupGrant} on registration.
Payments are processed by {entityLine} through Revolut Payments UAB as the payment service provider. Stated prices include tax where applicable.

sections.heading: 5. Credit
paragraphs: Credit is a prepaid value in euro cents that is used only to issue documents in the application. Credit has no expiry date and does not accrue interest.
Credit cannot be transferred between accounts and is not paid out in cash, except in the cases covered by the refund policy.

sections.heading: 6. User obligations
paragraphs: The user undertakes to use the service in accordance with the legislation of the Republic of Bulgaria, including the Accountancy Act and the Value Added Tax Act.
It is prohibited to use the service to issue documents with untrue content, to circumvent tax obligations, or to take actions that infringe the rights of third parties.
Attempts at automated load, intrusion, or disruption of the service's operation result in immediate termination of access.

sections.heading: 7. Liability
paragraphs: The service is provided as is. We make reasonable efforts to ensure its continuity and accuracy, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted operation.
The provider is not liable for the accuracy of data entered by the user, nor for the tax or accounting consequences of documents issued through the application.
The provider's liability for proven damages is limited to the amount paid by the user over the preceding twelve months.

sections.heading: 8. Termination
paragraphs: The user may stop using the service at any time by discontinuing access to their account and requesting its deletion at the email address given above.
The provider may terminate access in the event of a breach of these terms, notifying the user at their registered email address.
Issued documents remain the user's obligation under applicable accounting legislation even after access is terminated.

sections.heading: 9. Changes
paragraphs: These terms may be amended. The current version is always available at this address, with the date of the last update. Material changes are communicated to the registered email address no later than fourteen days before they take effect.

sections.heading: 10. Governing law
paragraphs: Bulgarian law applies to matters not covered here. Disputes are resolved by agreement, and failing that, by the competent Bulgarian court.
A consumer within the meaning of the Bulgarian Consumer Protection Act may file a complaint with the Consumer Protection Commission or use the European online dispute resolution platform.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This document explains what personal data {productName} processes, on what grounds, to whom it discloses it, and what rights each data subject has. The policy applies to the web application at {website}.

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: The controller is {entityLine}, email {supportEmail}.
For data the user enters about their own clients, the user is the controller and Fakturcho acts as a data processor on the user's instructions.

sections.heading: 2. What data we process
paragraphs: Account data: email address, name, and a cryptographically hashed record of the password.

Issuer data: company name, EIK (Bulgarian unified identification code), VAT number, address, authorized representative, bank account, and the person who drew up the document. This data is printed on issued documents.
Client and document data: the recipient's name and identifiers, addresses, catalogue items, amounts and dates, as entered by the user.
Technical data: access logs, request time, request address and response code, kept for security and troubleshooting purposes.
We do not process special categories of personal data and we do not carry out automated decision-making or profiling.

sections.heading: 3. Purposes and legal grounds
paragraphs: Providing the service and maintaining the account — processing is necessary for performance of the contract with the user.
Processing payments and keeping the credit balance — performance of a contract and compliance with legal obligations.
Service security, abuse prevention and technical support — the controller's legitimate interest.
Compliance with accounting and tax obligations — a legal obligation.

sections.heading: 4. Recipients and processors
paragraphs: Revolut Payments UAB — processes payments as the payment service provider. Receives the email address and payment data. {productName} does not store bank card data.
Railway Corporation — hosting of the application and the database.
Resend, Inc. — sending transactional emails when the user chooses to send a document by email.
Where a recipient processes data outside the European Economic Area, the transfer is based on standard contractual clauses adopted by the European Commission.
We do not sell personal data and do not provide it for advertising purposes.

sections.heading: 5. Retention periods
paragraphs: Account data and content entered by the user is retained for as long as the account exists.
After a deletion request, data is removed within thirty days, except for records we are legally required to keep.
Technical access logs are retained for up to twelve months.

sections.heading: 6. Data subject rights
paragraphs: Every natural person has the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability, and objection to processing based on legitimate interest.
These rights are exercised by a request to {supportEmail}. We reply within one month.
In case of a suspected violation, any person may file a complaint with the Bulgarian Commission for Personal Data Protection, Sofia, 2 Prof. Tsvetan Lazarov Blvd.

sections.heading: 7. Cookies
paragraphs: We use only strictly necessary cookies — a session cookie that keeps the account signed in. It is required for the service to work and does not require consent.
We do not use advertising or tracking cookies and do not embed third-party analytics scripts.

sections.heading: 8. Security
paragraphs: Access to the application is password-protected and the connection is encrypted. Every account sees only its own data; separation is enforced at the database query level.

In the event of a security breach that creates a high risk to the rights of affected persons, we notify the Commission for Personal Data Protection and the affected persons within the applicable deadlines.

refunds.metaDescription: When and how Fakturcho refunds amounts paid.
refunds.title: Refund Policy
refunds.intro: This policy describes when and how amounts paid for credit and subscriptions in {productName} are refunded.

sections.heading: 1. Who processes payments
paragraphs: Payments are processed through Revolut Payments UAB as the payment service provider. Refunds are ordered by us to the same card or account used for the purchase.
A request is submitted to {supportEmail} with the order number from the payment confirmation.

sections.heading: 2. Unused credit
paragraphs: Unused credit is refunded in full on request within fourteen days of purchasing the pack.
If part of the pack has been spent, the remainder corresponding to the unused credit is refunded.

sections.heading: 3. Used credit
paragraphs: Credit spent to issue a document is not refundable. Issuing claims a number from the numbering series and creates an accounting document — the service has been performed at that moment.
The price for issuing a single document is {perDocument}. Composing drafts does not spend credit and is not charged.

sections.heading: 4. Subscription
paragraphs: A subscription of {subscription} can be cancelled at any time. Access remains until the end of the paid period, after which it is not renewed.
The fee paid for the current period is not partially refunded, unless the service was unavailable through our fault for more than three consecutive days.

sections.heading: 5. Right of withdrawal for consumers
paragraphs: A consumer within the meaning of the Bulgarian Consumer Protection Act has the right to withdraw from the contract within fourteen days, without stating a reason.
Where the user has expressly agreed for the service to begin immediately, the right of withdrawal lapses for the portion already used, under Art. 57 of the Consumer Protection Act.

sections.heading: 6. Processing time
paragraphs: Approved refunds are ordered within five business days. The time it takes for the amount to reach the payer's account depends on their bank or card issuer and is usually three to ten business days.
If a request is declined, you receive a reasoned reply at the email address it was submitted from.

hero.title: Fatture a norma per aziende di tutta l'UE
hero.subtitle: Un'app web per aziende e lavoratori autonomi di tutta l'UE. Crei il documento nel browser: a numerazione, gestione dell'IVA, impaginazione e fattura elettronica ci pensa Fakturcho.

capabilities.heading: Cosa puoi emettere
items: Fatture, proforma, note di credito e di debito, preventivi e documenti di trasporto.
Numerazione progressiva, senza salti né duplicati.
IVA per paese: aliquote locali, esenzioni e inversione contabile (reverse charge) per il B2B transfrontaliero, con verifica VIES in tempo reale della partita IVA del cliente.

Fatture elettroniche EN 16931 nel formato del tuo paese — XRechnung, FatturaPA, KSeF FA(3), Facturae, CIUS-RO — pronte da caricare sulla piattaforma nazionale (ANAF SPV, SDI, KSeF, Chorus Pro, FACe) o da inviare via Peppol.
Un PDF pronto nella lingua del tuo paese, da scaricare o inviare via email.

pricing.heading: Prezzi

payAsYouGo.title: A consumo
payAsYouGo.body: Per ogni documento emesso. Bozze, clienti e articoli di catalogo sono gratuiti. Il credito si ricarica in pacchetti da {packs}.

subscription.title: Abbonamento
subscription.footnote: Il credito non utilizzato si accumula. Disdici quando vuoi.

pricing.footnote: Un nuovo account riceve {signupGrant} di credito alla registrazione. I pagamenti sono gestiti tramite Revolut.

items.question: Cos'è Fakturcho?
items.answer: Un'app web per emettere documenti a norma UE — fatture, proforma, note di credito e di debito, preventivi e documenti di trasporto — con fatturazione elettronica strutturata integrata, senza installare nulla.

items.question: Quanto costa?
items.answer: 0,10 € per documento emesso; bozze, clienti e articoli di catalogo sono gratuiti; il credito si ricarica in pacchetti da 5 €, 10 € e 25 €; gli abbonamenti da 5, 10 e 25 € al mese offrono il doppio del credito, che si accumula; con un abbonamento, un documento costa 0,05 €.

items.question: Posso iniziare gratis?
items.answer: Sì: un nuovo account riceve 1 € di credito (10 documenti), senza bisogno di carta.

items.question: Quali paesi sono supportati?
items.answer: Qualsiasi impresa stabilita nel territorio IVA dell'UE può emettere documenti. La fattura elettronica strutturata nel formato nazionale viene generata per Germania, Francia, Italia, Polonia, Romania, Spagna e Bulgaria, pronta da caricare sulla piattaforma nazionale o da inviare via Peppol.

items.question: Come viene gestita l'IVA per un cliente in un altro paese UE?
items.answer: Inserisci la partita IVA del cliente: Fakturcho la verifica su VIES e, per un cliente B2B estero con partita IVA valida, applica l'inversione contabile (reverse charge) e riporta sul documento la dicitura obbligatoria.

items.question: Posso emettere fatture se non sono registrato ai fini IVA?
items.answer: Sì: i documenti di un emittente non registrato ai fini IVA riportano il motivo di esenzione previsto nel suo paese.

items.question: Che differenza c'è tra fattura proforma e fattura?
items.answer: La fattura proforma è un preventivo preliminare e non ha valore fiscale; la fattura è il documento fiscale ufficiale, con numero e data di effettuazione dell'operazione.

items.question: Come si corregge una fattura emessa?
items.answer: I documenti emessi non sono modificabili; le correzioni si effettuano con una nota di credito o di debito collegata al documento originale.

items.question: Come ottengo il PDF e l'XML della fattura elettronica?
items.answer: Entrambi vengono generati lato server: puoi scaricarli, inviarli via email al cliente oppure caricare tu stesso la fattura elettronica sulla piattaforma nazionale o inviarla via Peppol.
